in_latin.name: Thadeus
in_latin.meaning: Nomen quod significat servus Iesu, unus ex apostolis, qui a Iuda Ioanne vocatus est
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Thadeus significat servus Iesu, unus ex apostolis, qui a Iuda Ioanne vocatus est. Thadeus, unus ex duodecim apostolis, qui a Iuda Ioanne vocatus est, et qui ab apostolis Ioannis, Petri, et Iacobi, non solum per vocabulum, sed etiam per ministerium, qui ab eo fuit, distinguitur. Nomen Thadeus in Actis Apostolorum, in epistula ad Galatas et in epistula ad Thessalonicenses invenitur.

in_english.name: Tadeu
in_english.meaning: Name meaning servant of Jesus, one of Jesus' apostles, called by Judas Iscariot
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tadeu is derived from the Hebrew name תדאי, meaning servant of Jesus, one of Jesus' apostles, called by Judas Iscariot. Tadeu, one of the twelve apostles, called by Judas Iscariot, and distinguished from the apostles John, Peter, and James not only by name but also by ministry, which was from him. The name Tadeu is found in the Acts of the Apostles, in the Epistle to the Galatians and in the Epistle to the Thessalonians.
